mansehraApproval: Use the whole dated 2022 Mansehra polygon for this fictional map, including any later Tanawal territory inside it.

districts.name: Akali Phula Singh
heritage: Akali Phula Singh and the Battle of Nowshera, 1823
Pir Sabaq and Akali Phula Singh’s samadhi
Jehangira and the historic Indus crossing
Hund / Udabhanda and the Hindu Shahi kingdom
Khushal Khan Khattak and Akora Khattak
districts.summary: A commemoratively named Zilla combining the existing fictional Akali Phula Singh and Swabi districts. Towns, villages, shrines and monuments retain their original names. Panjtar and Totalai remain in the transferred Khado Khel polygon wherever they fall within it; no Panjtar tehsil is created. Pabbi remains in KP.

districts.name: Haripur
heritage: Hari Singh Nalwa and the founding of Haripur
Hazara’s historical connection with the Sikh Empire
districts.summary: The complete fictional Haripur and Abbottabad districts are consolidated under the Haripur name, administered from Abbottabad. Lora becomes Haro and Lower Tanawal becomes Sherwan without changing their polygons. Abbottabad city, Havelian and all other settlements retain their names. Sherwan remains in United Punjab and is excluded from Amb.

districts.name: Hazarawala
heritage: Syed Ahmad Shaheed and Shah Ismail Shaheed memorial sites
districts.summary: Hazarawala is a new fictional commemorative district name inspired by Mahan Singh Hazarawala, not an ancient name for this territory. It comprises the complete dated Mansehra, Baffa-Pakhal (Pakhli) and Balakot tehsil polygons. Balakot’s full mountain extent and Kaghan Valley are retained. Oghi and Darband belong to the separate Amb Union Territory.

amb.name: Amb
heritage: Historical relationships with the Sikh Empire and British administration
amb.limitation: Only the verified Oghi and Darband source polygons are assigned. Additional Tanawal and Phulra sub-tehsil boundaries are unavailable. Shergarh and Phulra are historical references, not invented administrative polygons. The modern fictional UT does not assert an exact reconstruction of the historical princely state. Former Lower Tanawal / Sherwan is excluded.
